hero.description: I'm Leonel Rosado — a frontend-focused developer from Mérida, México with 2 years of professional experience building web apps, ERPs, and client portals. I work with React, Vue.js 3, and PHP/Laravel to deliver clean, fast, and usable interfaces.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Building web experiences that actually work
about.bio_1: I'm a software engineer specializing in frontend development, based in Mérida, México. My degree in Digital Business and Virtual Environments gives me a broader view of how technology drives real business outcomes — not just how to write code.
about.bio_2: Over 2 years I've worked on custom web applications, ERPs, accounts-receivable systems, and client portals — always in professional, collaborative environments using agile methodologies.
about.bio_3: I'm now taking on freelance projects through Upwork. I work autonomously, communicate proactively, and bring the same attention to detail from my professional work to every client engagement.

experience_1.description: Built a custom Accounts Receivable system and a customer-facing client portal. First end-to-end experience in a production environment.

experience_2.description: Custom web application development. Contributed to building a full ERP system from scratch alongside a cross-functional team.

experience_3.description: Redesign, development and responsiveness improvements on established web applications. UI/UX enhancement across multiple production products.

project_1.title: Custom ERP System
project_1.desc: Full enterprise resource planning application covering inventory, purchasing, and reporting modules. Developed in a team environment with agile sprints and a version-controlled codebase.
project_1.role: Frontend module development — implemented inventory and reporting UIs and integrated them with the backend API.

project_2.title: Accounts Receivable System
project_2.desc: Custom-built financial management tool for tracking invoices, payment schedules, and client account balances. Replaced a manual spreadsheet workflow and improved the team's financial visibility.
project_2.role: Primary developer — designed the DB schema, built all views and logic, delivered as part of my internship.

project_3.title: Customer Self-Service Portal
project_3.desc: A B2B-facing portal allowing clients to check their account status, access documents, and submit requests online. Focused heavily on UX clarity and mobile responsiveness.
project_3.role: End-to-end development — frontend and backend implementation with a UX-first approach throughout.

project_4.title: Legacy App Redesign & Responsiveness
project_4.desc: Modernization of multiple existing production web applications — migrating desktop-only layouts to mobile-first designs, refactoring CSS architecture, and improving component structure.
project_4.role: Led the frontend redesign — assessed existing UIs, proposed improvements, and executed across several live applications.

service_1.title: Frontend development
service_1.desc: Custom UI implementation with React or Vue.js 3. Clean, component-based code that's readable, maintainable, and easy for your team to extend.

service_2.title: Responsive UI & redesigns
service_2.desc: Make your existing app look and feel great on any screen. I audit layouts, modernize design, and improve usability without breaking what already works.

service_3.title: Web apps & client portals
service_3.desc: Business tools, dashboards, and portals built from scratch. I have direct professional experience with these systems and can deliver them reliably.

service_4.title: PHP / Laravel backends
service_4.desc: Full-stack when you need it. I can build and connect Laravel APIs, MySQL databases, and auth systems to power your frontend application.

contact.label: GET IN TOUCH
contact.title: Let's build something together
contact.description: I'm currently available for freelance projects — short or long term. Whether you have a detailed brief or just an early idea, reach out and I'll respond within 24 hours.
